commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Juan Cruz (Leganes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+2' Mario Melero Lopez shows the yellow card to Robert Navarro (Mallorca) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' Juan Cruz (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Jose Copete (Mallorca) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Juan Soriano to get hold of the ball.
89' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Yvan Neyou (Leganes) for a tough tackle.
87' Juan Cruz (Leganes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
87' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Juan Cruz (Leganes), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
85' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) sees a yellow card from Mario Melero Lopez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
84' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Manu Morlanes will be replaced by Jose Copete (Mallorca).
84' That's the end of the game for Daniel Rodriguez, who is replaced by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).

82' Juan Cruz (Leganes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
81' The resulting free kick from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
80' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
79' Mario Melero Lopez interrupts the game. One of the players from Leganes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
78' The free kick is delivered by Juan Cruz (Leganes) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
77' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Mario Melero Lopez's book.
77' Juan Cruz (Leganes) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

75' A cross by Yvan Neyou (Leganes) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
75' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Leganes.
74' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul after Robert Navarro (Mallorca) hacks down one of his opponents. Leganes are awarded the free kick.
73' A long pass, executed by Darko Brasanac (Leganes), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Johan Mojica (Mallorca) replacing Toni Lato.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch for Takuma Asano.
71' Leganes are ruled offside.
70' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Leganes.
70' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leganes.
69' Handball by Juan Cruz (Leganes). It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
69' Juan Cruz (Leganes) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
69' The attendance for today's match is 10482.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is replacing Javi Hernandez.
64' Diego Garcia (Leganes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca have a free kick.
64' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. Leganes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
63' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
62' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Robert Navarro (Mallorca) replaces Marc Domenech.
61' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
57' Substitution. Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) on for Oscar Rodriguez.
57' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Adria Altimira and he is replaced by Valentin Rosier (Leganes).
56' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
54' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Munir El Haddadi will not participate anymore and Enric Franquesa (Leganes) is coming on.
46' Borja Jimenez makes a switch. Juan Cruz (Leganes) is coming on in place of Dani Raba at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Renato Tapia is replaced by Yvan Neyou (Leganes).
46' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

43' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Vedat Muriqi and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

42' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Leganes will take a free kick near the side line.
39' The linesman raises his flag. Diego Garcia (Leganes) is adjudged offside.
36' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
35' Dani Raba (Leganes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
33' Pablo Maffeo has picked up an injury and is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
32' Excellent touch by Javi Hernandez (Leganes)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
30' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
30' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Mallorca have a corner.
29' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Mallorca is cautioned for aggressive play. A free kick is awarded to Leganes.
28' He should have scored! Takuma Asano (Mallorca) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
28' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' A crossfield pass from Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates.

24' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
23' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Juan Soriano and he makes a comfortable save.

21' A player from Leganes commits a rough challenge. Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
19' Dani Raba (Leganes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dominik Greif, who smothers the ball.
17' Mallorca are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

14' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.

13' Diego Garcia (Leganes) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Dominik Greif, who pulls off a comfortable save!
13' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Renato Tapia (Leganes) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Leganes.
11' Toni Lato (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero Lopez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Leganes will take a free kick.

9' A short pass finds Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
9' Toni Lato (Mallorca) makes a slide tackle, but referee Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. Leganes get a free kick.
8' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
7' Renato Tapia (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick.
6' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Poor challenge! Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) is penalised for tripping and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle. Free kick. Mallorca will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
4' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
1' Renato Tapia (Leganes) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez was nominated as the referee for this game.
